sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellants seeks for and is granted permission to withdraw this first criminal appeal with liberty to surrender before the trial Court and file regular bail application.
It is further prayed that trial Court be directed to decide the regular bail application of the appellants as expeditiously as possible.
With aforesaid liberty, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
Trial Court is directed to decide the regular bail application of the appellants, if filed, as expeditiously as possible, in accordance with law.
